name: Proving Grounds
summary: In Alterac, recruits face a trial before they may join the Stormpike Guard. Lieutenant Haggerdin sends them into Icewing Caverns for a planted battle standard. Success earns an official Stormpike Insignia and opens the way through the expedition’s ranks.

sections.title: A Measure of Courage
sections.body: The Stormpike Guard fights the Frostwolf Clan in Alterac Valley. Lieutenant Haggerdin directs Alliance forces from their encampment in the Alterac Mountains. Before recruits reach the battlefield, he tests their skill and nerve in Icewing Caverns southwest of Dun Baldar.

sections.title: The Icewing Caverns
sections.body: Deep in Icewing Caverns, a Stormpike banner waits among the frozen tunnels. Frost harpies nest in the icy recesses and attack unwary trespassers. A recruit who brings the banner back intact has crossed dangerous ground, faced its predators, and kept discipline under pressure.

sections.title: The Stormpike Insignia
sections.body: Return from the caverns with the standard, and you earn a Stormpike initiate’s insignia and a place in the expeditionary force. Haggerdin says the insignia can improve as you earn greater honor on the battlefield. The Eye of Command is one distant aim.

faq.answer: Lieutenant Haggerdin is an Alliance officer in the Alterac Mountains who oversees Stormpike Guard recruitment and field recognition. He tests prospective fighters and rewards their service with military insignias.
Icewing Caverns lie southwest of Dun Baldar, the Alliance stronghold in Alterac Valley. Their winding tunnels run beneath ice and stone.

faq.q: What threats dwell inside the Icewing Caverns?
faq.answer: Ferocious ice harpies live in Icewing Caverns. Haggerdin warns that they ambush trespassers and tear out their throats.

faq.q: Why does the Stormpike Guard require this test?
faq.answer: The Stormpike Guard fights a brutal war against the Frostwolf orcs. Haggerdin tests recruits before they join the main lines, so each soldier bearing the banner can fight in harsh conditions.

faq.q: What is the reward for completing the proving ground?
faq.answer: Return with the standard, and you earn a Stormpike initiate’s insignia. Haggerdin can improve it as you gain honor in Alterac Valley.

faq.q: Who are the Frostwolves mentioned by Haggerdin?
faq.answer: The Frostwolf Clan is an orcish clan that has lived in Alterac Valley since its exile decades ago. The Stormpike Guard sees them as hostile savages who obstruct Alliance interests and excavation in the valley.

angles.text: The Stormpike expedition is the Alliance’s main military effort in Alterac. It joins dwarven archaeological ambitions with the defense of Alliance territory against the Horde.
As a dwarf, you join a guard led mostly by Ironforge dwarves who seek ancestral relics and titan mysteries. This trial can be your first step into one of your race’s proudest military units.
